Mahtab Uddin Ahmed Chowdhury (Minar) ------ Respondent
full_judgment:
Surendra Kumar Sinha J: This petition is directed from an interim order enlarging the accused-respondent Mahtab Uddin Ahmed Chowdhury (Minar) on bail for a period of 6 (six) months. This Case has a Chequered history of its own. A sitting Upazilla Chairman of Fhulgazi, district Feni was assassinated on broad day light at about 10-30 AM on 20th May, 2014 when he was approaching' towards Fhulgazi in front of Bilashi Cinema Hall. Over the said incident, the informant who is the brother of the deceased portrayed the accused respondent as the principal assailant, who allegedly organized the killing squad by hiring terrorists over election rivalry. The post-mortem shows four stabs wounds inflicted on the person of the victim, which caused the death. In the said case 16 accused persons made confessional statements, some of them implicated the accused. The police in the meantime submitted charge sheet, against him and other accused persons on 20th August, 2014. The case is at the trial stage. 

 2. Earlier this accused moved the High Court Division in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 25451 of 2014 and secured.an interim order on 16-7-2014. State moved this Court against the said order in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 461 of 2014, This Court by order dated 20-7-2014; stayed the operation of the interim order of bail. He then moved another petition is criminal Miscellanies Case No. 49835 of 2014 and obtained an interim order of bail on medical grounds. 

 4. The High Court Division enlarged him on ad interim bail by order dated 2-3-2015 against on medical ground. The State again moved this Court against the said order. This court set aside the said order in Criminal Petition No. 182 of 2015. Thereafter, the accused again moved the High Court Division for bail in Criminal Miscellaneous case No. 5011 of 2016. A Division Bench of the High Court Division having noticed that this Court rejected his prayer for bail earlier on merit by order dated 17-1-2016 summarily rejected the petition. 

 5. Thereafter, the accused moved another petition for bail in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 10892 of 2016. In course of hearing of the petition, learned Attorney-General opposed the prayer for bail pointing out that the accused is involved in a sensational murder case and this Division interfered with the orders of bail granted by the High Court Division on many occasions and that another Division Bench of the High Court Division had also rejected his prayer for bail recently. Though the High Court Division noticed the orders of this Court in Criminal Petition Nos. 182 of 2015, 192 of 2015, by which, it set aside this orders of bail granted by the High Court Division, enlarged him on bail on medical grounds for 6(six) months by the impugned order. Against this order the State moved this Court. 

 "This is to certify that Mr Mahtab Uddin Ahmed Chowdhury age-59 years, Patient ID # 14A70416, has been re-admitted in Ibrahim Cardiac Hospital & Research Institute since 9-7-2015 with intermittent episodes of compressive chest pain. He is a diabetic hypertensive, dyslipidemia gentleman, diagnosed as a case of revere oriole vessel coronary artery disease (80% in LAD, 90% in RI, 90% in Lex and 80% in Omit and Mount Elizabeth Hospital, Singapore (10-2-2010) and was trend recommended for CABO. Since then he has suffered from episodes of unstable angina & NSTEMI requiring several hospital admissions, following which angioplasty was done on 5-3-2015 at Ibrahim Cardiac Hospital. However, he continues to suffer from severe compressive chest pain intermittently despite optimal treatment including PTCA. In addition he is also a patient of chronic kidney disease (CKD) and with recent. Admission in June 2015 due to Acute Kidney Injury (AKI). He also has Bronchial asthma, Lumbar spondylosis, Benign Enlargement of Prostate (BEP), fatty liver disease and multinodular goiter. He underwent transplanted stem cell and Chinese osmotherapy for his kidney condition at Shijiazhuang Kidney Disease Hospital, China. Although the full course needed 45-60 days and he managed only 21 days and could not complete the recommended, course and advised him to complete the course in future. They have also expressed concern that the thyroid gland could be an adverse outcome of incomplete stem cell therapy, and requires tnore extensive valuation. He also has a recent onset of back pain radiating to the fright hip joint which has aggravated for the last 1 month. 

 10. But according to it, his present condition is stable. The opinion is that the "Patient is found Haemodynamically stable and his cardiac status is satisfactory" and that the 'patient is physically fit to appear before the court for trial.' On being satisfied about the condition of the accused the BSMMU authority sent the accused to the Dhaka Central Jail without awaiting any decision from this Court. From the above report, which has been submitted by a strong medical board comprising with 8 (eight) specialized doctors of a recognized hospital, which is one of the pioneers in the research of medical science, we are convinced that the accused-respondent has not only misled the court below, he has also misland the High Court Division and this Court as well by showing various ailments of serious nature and in connivance with the doctors. he has secured the order of bail. He has also prevented the trial court to proceed with the trial of the case. 

 12. By these reports the trial of a sensational murder case is being delayed and thereby, they have been interfering with the administration of justice. By sending him to Ibrahim Cardiac Hospital instead of sending him to BSMMU, the doctors of the Central Jail. Hospital, who are public servants have misused their power and position for which, exemplary actions should be taken against them. Accordingly, we direct the Inspector General of Prisons to immediately withdraw the Civil Surgeon and Medical Officer, alongwith Diplob Kanti Biswas and Dr Md Ahsan Habib, Assistant Surgeons, jail hospital from their responsibilities in the said hospital and take legal action against them and to intimate this Court within two weeks form date as to what legal action has been taken against them. Similarly, the conduct of professor Dr MA Rashid and Professor Lt. Col. (Retd) Md Rezaul Karim of Ibrahim Cardiac Hospital and Research. Institute is deprecated. We caution them not to recur similar unethical acts in future. 

 13. The Rule issued by the High Court Division is discharged. The ad interim bail granted to the accused respondent is cancelled. The Central Jail Authority is directed to send the accused Mahtab uddin Ahmed Chowdhury (Minar) to Feni District jail for facing trial in the case. This petition is disposed of with the above observations and direction.
